title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals the T lymphocyte microenvironment and identifies HOPX as a hub gene in membranous nephropathy.
authors: Li, Yao; Wang, Yaoyao; Hou, Yanjiao; Zheng, Qing; Zhang, Wei; Yang, Xiancong
one_liner_zh: 该文为膜性肾病的单细胞转录组分析，聚焦T淋巴细胞微环境与HOPX诊断标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Membranous nephropathy (MN) is an autoimmune disease characterized by immune complex deposition and progressive renal function impairment. Although studies have demonstrated that dysregulation of adaptive immunity, primarily T lymphocyte dysregulation, plays a significant role in its pathogenesis through heterogeneity, the understanding of immune cell subpopulations and key immune response genes during the pathological process of MN remains incomplete. METHODS: This study integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from GSE193512 with bulk RNA sequencing (bulk RNA-seq) data from GSE142025. Through differential expression analysis, high-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA), pseudotime trajectory inference, and cell-cell communication analysis, the composition of the immune cell microenvironment and gene regulatory changes were systematically analyzed. Meanwhile, four machine learning algorithms were employed in combination to screen for hub genes. We collected clinical blood samples from 53 MN patients and healthy controls, and performed experimental validation via qRT-PCR and flow cytometry. RESULTS: The results indicated significant expansion of peripheral blood CD8-positive T cells and natural killer cells in PLA2R-positive patients, and the functional states of these cells were markedly altered in non-remission MN cases. In the scRNA-seq data, ten key module genes within T cells, including GNLY, NKG7, GZMB, KLRD1, HOPX, and ZEB2, were identified using the hdWGCNA algorithm and the combined screening of four machine learning algorithms. Multi-algorithm integration consistently identified HOPX as a core hub gene. HOPX expression was significantly upregulated in the peripheral blood of MN patients, and qRT-PCR and ROC curve analysis confirmed its diagnostic performance. Cell-cell communication analysis revealed that T cells and NK cells form an active interaction network through signaling pathways such as MIF and GZMA, suggesting a central role for these pathways in the immune response. CONCLUSION: In summary, this study presents a high-resolution single-cell sequencing-based immune cell landscape of MN and establishes HOPX as a potential novel diagnostic biomarker for the first time. It elucidates the crucial roles of lymphocyte dysfunction, metabolic remodeling, and immune exhaustion in disease progression. These findings not only deepen the understanding of the immunopathogenesis of MN but also provide important theoretical basis and candidate targets for developing targeted immunotherapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：膜性肾病（membranous nephropathy, MN）是一种以免疫复合物沉积和进行性肾功能损害为特征的自身免疫性疾病。尽管研究表明，适应性免疫失调，主要是T淋巴细胞失调，通过异质性在其发病机制中发挥重要作用，但对MN病理过程中免疫细胞亚群和关键免疫反应基因的理解仍不完整。方法：本研究整合了GSE193512的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据与GSE142025的批量RNA测序（bulk RNA-seq）数据。通过差异表达分析、高维加权基因共表达网络分析（hdWGCNA）、伪时间轨迹推断和细胞间通讯分析，系统分析了免疫细胞微环境的组成和基因调控变化。同时，结合四种机器学习算法筛选核心基因。我们收集了53名MN患者和健康对照者的临床血液样本，并通过qRT-PCR和流式细胞术进行了实验验证。结果：结果表明，在PLA2R阳性患者中，外周血CD8阳性T细胞和自然杀伤细胞显著扩增，且在非缓解型MN病例中，这些细胞的功能状态显著改变。在scRNA-seq数据中，使用hdWGCNA算法和四种机器学习算法的联合筛选，识别出T细胞内的十个关键模块基因，包括GNLY、NKG7、GZMB、KLRD1、HOPX和ZEB2。多算法整合一致将HOPX确定为核心枢纽基因。HOPX在MN患者外周血中表达显著上调，qRT-PCR和ROC曲线分析确认了其诊断性能。细胞间通讯分析显示，T细胞和NK细胞通过MIF和GZMA等信号通路形成活跃的相互作用网络，提示这些通路在免疫反应中的核心作用。结论：总之，本研究基于高分辨率单细胞测序呈现了MN的免疫细胞图谱，并首次将HOPX确立为潜在的新型诊断生物标志物。它阐明了淋巴细胞功能障碍、代谢重塑和免疫耗竭在疾病进展中的关键作用。这些发现不仅加深了对MN免疫发病机制的理解，也为开发靶向免疫治疗策略提供了重要的理论基础和候选靶点。
